# Cafe Delites

> > Easy, delicious recipes featuring healthy ingredients and cooking methods for home cooks of all levels.

Cafe Delites is a recipe website created by Karina, an Australian home cook and author. The site features a comprehensive collection of healthy, accessible recipes alongside Karina's memoir about surviving Hodgkin's Lymphoma, blending culinary inspiration with personal wellness.

## Key Topics

- Healthy Recipes
- Easy Cooking
- Home Cooking
- Air Fryer Recipes
- Low-Fat Meals
- Comfort Food
- Meal Planning
- Recipe Categories
- Dietary Preferences
- Cooking Methods
- Recipe Search
- Karina
- Australia
- Hodgkin's Lymphoma
- Liberation Memoir

## Recipe Collections

- [Recipes - Cafe Delites](https://cafedelites.com/recipes): Complete recipe index and search for all Cafe Delites recipes, organized by category, cooking method, and dietary preferences
- [Easy Delicious Recipes with Healthy Ingredients - Cafe Delites](https://cafedelites.com): Cafe Delites homepage featuring easy healthy recipes by Karina with meal ideas, air fryer recipes, and low-fat comfort food

## About & Memoir

- [LIBERATION - Breaking The Chains To Survival And Freedom - Cafe Delites](https://cafedelites.com/about/liberation-breaking-the-chains-to-survival-and-freedom): Karina's cancer memoir about surviving Hodgkin's Lymphoma, sharing her personal journey and wellness philosophy

## Media & Press

- [MEDIA - Cafe Delites](https://cafedelites.com/media): Media coverage and press features of Karina and Cafe Delites, including appearances on Channel 7's Today Tonight and other publications
